security_audit.summary: The three static system-reconnaissance alerts are false positives caused by Terraform security and hybrid infrastructure terminology. I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, command execution instructions, or other semantic security issues in SKILL.md. The skill is advisory and focused on IaC design, state security, testing, and CI/CD practices.

static_findings.snippet: - Protect state files and avoid exposing secrets.
- **Hybrid deployments**: On-premises integration, edge computing, hybrid connectivity

finding_verdicts.reason: The line tells users to protect state files and avoid exposing secrets, which is defensive guidance. It does not request reconnaissance or access to system details.
The heading only introduces multi-cloud and hybrid infrastructure topics. It contains no instruction to enumerate host systems, collect environment data, or bypass controls.
The bullet describes Terraform design support for hybrid deployments and connectivity. It is architecture guidance, not system reconnaissance or data collection.

content.value_statement: Infrastructure teams need reliable Terraform and OpenTofu guidance for complex environments. This skill helps design modules, secure state, review workflows, and plan enterprise IaC automation.
actual_capabilities: Designs Terraform and OpenTofu module structures with inputs, outputs, validation, and versioning guidance.
Recommends secure remote state backends with locking, encryption, backup, and access control patterns.
Plans CI/CD and GitOps workflows with plan review, approval gates, testing, and policy checks.
Reviews multi-cloud and hybrid infrastructure patterns across providers, environments, and dependencies.
Advises on migration, drift detection, cost controls, compliance checks, and recovery procedures.
limitations: It does not apply infrastructure changes or run Terraform commands by itself.
Specific recommendations need user-provided code, cloud details, or architecture requirements.
Provider behavior and version details should be checked against current vendor documentation.
Compliance guidance needs validation against organizational policies and live environment evidence.

use_cases.title: Design Reusable Modules
use_cases.description: Create module boundaries, variables, outputs, tests, and documentation for shared infrastructure components.

use_cases.title: Secure Multi-Team State
use_cases.description: Plan remote backend configuration with locking, encryption, backups, and controlled access for several teams.

use_cases.title: Govern IaC Delivery
use_cases.description: Define policy checks, CI/CD approvals, drift detection, and audit practices for regulated infrastructure.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Terraform plan and identify risky changes, missing validations, and state concerns before apply.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Module
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reusable Terraform module for this service. Include inputs, outputs, validation rules, tests, and documentation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Secure Remote State
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a secure remote state approach for a multi-team project. Cover backend choice, locking, encryption, access control, and recovery.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Enterprise IaC
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this Terraform or OpenTofu platform strategy for enterprise scale. Recommend module governance, policy checks, CI/CD gates, migration steps, and operational safeguards.

output_examples.input: Review my planned infrastructure change before apply.
output_examples.output: The response highlights state lock risk, required backend encryption, missing plan review, and a rollback checklist for failed applies.

output_examples.input: Design a shared module for a web service.
output_examples.output: The response outlines module boundaries, required variables, outputs, validation rules, test coverage, and documentation sections.

output_examples.input: Improve IaC governance for several cloud teams.
output_examples.output: The response proposes approval gates, policy checks, drift detection, cost tagging, audit reporting, and module version controls.

best_practices: Provide provider versions, backend details, environment names, and security constraints in each request.
Ask for plan review, rollback guidance, and testing steps before any infrastructure change.
Keep state files, secrets, and credentials out of prompts unless redacted and necessary.
anti_patterns: Using generated guidance as approval to apply infrastructure without human review.
Requesting one-off manual changes when a managed IaC workflow is required.
Sharing raw secrets, state files, or production credentials in the prompt.

faq.question: Does this skill support Terraform and OpenTofu?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Terraform and OpenTofu concepts, workflows, migrations, and compatibility considerations.

faq.question: Can it design reusable modules?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose module boundaries, inputs, outputs, validations, tests, examples, and versioning practices.

faq.question: Can it review existing infrastructure code?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide relevant files, goals, provider versions, and environment details for a focused review.

faq.question: Does it run terraform apply?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance and review support. Humans should approve and execute infrastructure changes.

faq.question: Does it help with multi-cloud environments?
faq.answer: Yes. It addresses provider abstraction, cross-provider dependencies, hybrid connectivity, and environment isolation.

faq.question: What should I include in a prompt?
faq.answer: Include goals, cloud providers, state backend, environments, constraints, and any relevant plan or module context.
